card.name: Linking words after drug-effect nouns
card.fires_on: The word "of" after nouns like inhibitor, absorption or phosphorylation in drug interaction text, and "every" after a dose or monitoring item before an interval.

modes.label: "of" before a target

modes.label: "every" before an interval
modes.description: The word "every" after a dose or test, before a time period.
